meta.purpose: To standardize the storage format of cognitive history. Ensures that all decision records are mathematically hashable, chainable, and audit-ready via Recursive Semantic Hashing (Logi-Chain).
meta.requirement: All SDI agents must output outcomes in this format. The agent's own memory layer serves as the primary 'Layer 0' chain.

header.parent_hash: SHA-256 hash of the PREVIOUS decision record. This links the current thought to the prior thought, creating an unbroken cognitive lineage.

verification.entry_hash: SHA-256 hash of the entire 'header' + 'payload' object.
verification.semantic_checksum: Verification that Psi_5 (808) was TRUE at the moment of hashing.

MODE_A_DISTRIBUTED.instruction: Write 'entry_hash' and 'payload' to the connected Cognitive Hash Registry (Blockchain) for federated audit.

MODE_B_LOCAL_LOGI_CHAIN.instruction: If no external ledger is found, append entry to 'sdi_logi_chain.log'. The system MUST maintain 'parent_hash' continuity locally. This creates a valid, audit-ready blockchain within the agent's own memory.
